assertions.name: a policy that never quotes earns exactly zero
assertions.why: non-zero means someone else's fills are being credited to us, which no downstream averaging would reveal

assertions.name: a policy that never quotes gets no fills
inventory equals the signed sum of fills
assertions.why: inventory must not be tracked independently of the fills

assertions.name: two identical runs agree
assertions.why: without determinism a paired comparison between policies is meaningless

assertions.name: real-arm fidelity does not regress
assertions.why: replaying real messages must keep reproducing the recorded real book

assertions.name: inputs are the declared baseline
assertions.why: set at record time after checking the episode data against the previously recorded fingerprint; CI cannot re-check it because the data is not in the repository

assertions.name: real arm beats the gen arm
assertions.why: the asymmetry is what shows the engine is not the source of divergence

assertions.name: the real arm reproduces the whole book, not just the touch
assertions.why: mid only watches the touch; on this same data it read 5/8 while the full book read 0/8

assertions.name: the gen arm reproduces the whole book
assertions.why: the saved generated stream must reconstruct the book the generator recorded, or the market a policy is scored in is not the market that was generated

assertions.name: the lookup-miss sentinel volume has not moved
assertions.why: invisible to every fidelity assertion, so it needs its own

what: behavioural claims measured on the cluster against real market data
